author_notes: Hardened to L4 with a genre-native lever. The nuxt-ui-templates chat home's own starter quick prompts become a Prompt library: a category tab row (All/Frameworks/Styling/Data & tools) filters the real prompt cards and a live readout shows 'Showing N of 7 · <Category>'. The same PromptLibrary.vue component renders on the home and on a dedicated /prompts route (app/pages/prompts.vue). Three leg-varying source files: PromptLibrary.vue (filter+count wiring), app/assets/css/promptlib.css (responsive wrap + card grid layout), and prompts.vue (whether the /prompts route surfaces the library). The bad solution collapses the whole library region on the default desktop state (fixed nowrap tab row that clips, negative-margin cards that shingle into an illegible pile, near-white-on-near-white active tab) and freezes the readout so a tab click toggles the highlight but never recomputes the count; it also drops the library from /prompts. Reference wraps cleanly, filters correctly, and surfaces the library on both routes. INFRA (identical across legs): seed the time-based greeting via useState to remove a pre-existing hydration mismatch; disable build sourcemaps. No new dependencies, no remote media, no template swap. The prompt library image assets and favicon stay untouched.
design_constraints: Preserve the existing Nuxt UI chat shell: sidebar, Chat logo, New chat/Search actions, GitHub login, greeting, UChatPrompt, model selector, upload button, search modal, and theme controls.
Build the Prompt library from the app's own starter prompts (the real quick-prompt cards); do not bolt on a detached metric dashboard or unrelated section.
The category filter must live inside the library the user browses before starting a chat, filtering the real cards and driving a live count readout.
Surface the library consistently on the chat home and on the /prompts route so the browsing state carries across both surfaces.
Keep Claude Haiku 4.5, Gemini 3 Flash, GPT-5 Nano, the original prompt labels, and the search modal available.
Desktop, tablet, and mobile must avoid horizontal overflow; the tab row and card grid must wrap and stay legible with the prompt, model selector, upload affordance usable.

The file upload button, model selector, prompt submit button, search modal, and theme controls remain present.

responsive: desktop_initial, tablet_initial, and mobile_initial protect the prompt surface across viewports; mobile_initial and mobile_prompts must have no horizontal overflow.
The tab row and card grid wrap on narrow viewports without clipping or overflow.

metadata.design_goal: grow the chat home's starter prompts into a filterable, counted Prompt library (category tabs + live count) surfaced on the home and a /prompts route, wrapping responsively and staying legible
metadata.source_repo_kind: Nuxt AI chat template with stateful prompt input, attachment upload composable, model selector, quick prompt cards, search modal, sidebar navigation, session login, and API routes for chats/uploads

problem_statement: This Nuxt AI chat template greets the user on the chat home and offers a set of starter quick prompts. Upgrade the home into a browsable Prompt library: turn the starter prompts into a filterable, counted library with a category tab row (All, Frameworks, Styling, Data & tools) over the real prompt cards, and a live readout that reads 'Showing N of 7 · <Category>'. Clicking a category tab must filter the visible cards and recompute the readout. Surface the same library on a dedicated /prompts route as well as on the home screen. The library row must wrap responsively so the chat landing never overflows horizontally at a 390px mobile width, the active tab and the cards must stay legible, and the existing chat shell (sidebar, Chat logo, New chat, Search, Login with GitHub, UChatPrompt, model selector, upload affordance, search modal, theme controls) must keep working. Implement in the current Nuxt/Vue source without new dependencies, remote media, or replacing the template.
required_content: Render a Prompt library on the chat home AND on a dedicated /prompts route, each showing the category tab row (All, Frameworks, Styling, Data & tools) over the real starter-prompt cards.
The category tabs must filter the visible cards and update a live readout that reads 'Showing N of 7 · <Category>' (e.g. clicking Frameworks shows 'Showing 3 of 7 · Frameworks').
The tab row and card grid must wrap responsively so the chat landing has no horizontal overflow at 390px (within 24px tolerance).
The active tab and the prompt cards must stay legible (no dark-on-dark or white-on-white); the cards must not overlap or shingle over each other.
Keep the existing chat shell visible and working: sidebar, New chat, Search, Login with GitHub, UChatPrompt, upload affordance, model selector, submit button, and theme controls.
Keep the model menu interaction working with Claude Haiku 4.5, Gemini 3 Flash, and GPT-5 Nano visible.
Implement the change in the current Nuxt/Vue source structure without new dependencies, remote media, or replacing the chat template.
state_constraints: desktop_initial, tablet_initial, and mobile_initial protect the chat prompt surface and the Prompt library (tab row + card grid + readout) across viewports; mobile_initial is where an unwrapped library forces horizontal overflow.
desktop_home_frameworks performs a deterministic click on the Frameworks category tab and protects the filter+count behavior: the readout must recompute to 'Showing 3 of 7 · Frameworks'.
desktop_prompts and mobile_prompts protect the dedicated /prompts route rendering the same Prompt library.
desktop_model_menu performs a deterministic click on the Claude Haiku 4.5 selector and protects the model-option menu.
